# CyberCubeandBlackpandaPartnertoEnhanceCyberRiskAnalyticsforBrokersAcrossAsia

CyberCube and Blackpanda partner to bring APAC regional cyber risk benchmarks to brokers across Asia through Broking Manager.

- Oct 13 2026

- 3 Minute Read

_LONDON, 13th October, 2026_ – CyberCube and Blackpanda have today unveiled a partnership to bring cyber risk analytics to brokers across Asia, pairing CyberCube's modeling platform with Blackpanda's incident-response presence in the region.

Cyber risk models used across Asia have typically been benchmarked against a single global average. Under the new collaboration, [Broking Manager](https://www.cybcube.com/broking-manager), CyberCube's cyber-risk analytics platform for brokers used across 40 countries, now adds an APAC regional view to CyberCube's existing loss severity, incident frequency, and security posture benchmarks. This move will enable peer comparisons to reflect the market brokers' clients operate in.

As part of the partnership, Blackpanda will refer local brokers across Asia to CyberCube and license Broking Manager for use with its own broker relationships, while its [incident response team](https://hubs.li/Q04ySrhr0) remains on call for referred clients. CyberCube has also licensed Blackpanda's aggregated, anonymized incident data for regional research.

Brokers in Asia can [request an introduction](https://hubs.li/Q04ySrkR0) to Broking Manager through Blackpanda.

Nate Brink, Head of Broker Sales & Account Management, CyberCube, said: "Brokers across Asia have told us for years that a single global benchmark doesn't reflect what they're actually seeing in the market. This partnership brings Broking Manager's regional benchmarking to brokers across Asia, backed by Blackpanda's reach and incident response expertise in the region, so they can have a more grounded conversation with their clients about exposure and coverage."

“Clients are asking their brokers harder questions about cyber exposure and how much cover is enough," said Gene Yu, Founder and CEO of Blackpanda. "Broking Manager gives brokers a structured way to answer them: the financial-loss analytics and peer-benchmarking insights they need to prepare for client conversations. When an incident happens, their clients can call on our responders, recognised by Frost & Sullivan as [Asia-Pacific's Incident Response Company of the Year](https://hubs.li/Q04ySrsl0) for three years running. Keeping advice and response this close together serves everyone in that conversation."

**About CyberCube**

CyberCube is the leading provider of software-as-a-service cyber risk analytics to quantify cyber risk in financial terms. CyberCube leverages data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and human resources to serve insurance institutions globally. The CyberCube platform was established in 2015 within Symantec and has operated as a standalone company since 2018. With offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn, Estonia, the team is committed to helping organizations and society build resilience to cyber risk. For more information, please visit www.cybcube.com or email [info@cybcube.com](mailto:info@cybcube.com).

**About Blackpanda**

[Blackpanda](https://hubs.li/Q04ySrh-0) is Asia's leading cyber incident response company, delivering digital emergency response across three integrated channels: IR consulting, IR-1 assurance subscriptions, and Lloyd's of London-underwritten cyber insurance. Each is purpose-built for a different buyer, whether enterprise, mass market, or sophisticated risk-transfer clients, and each stands alone as full incident response. Together, these channels reach the entire commercial market, because our mission is to provide digital emergency response for everyone. Buy all three and they combine into the complete post-attack recovery solution: preparation in advance, response the moment you're hit, and financial recovery paid for by insurance. One local team to help you get ready, respond, and recover.
